ayahs.ar: ال࢜رٰࣞ تِلْكَ اٰيٰتُ الْكِتٰبِ وَقُرْاٰنٍ مُّبِيْنٍ ۝١
ayahs.tr: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur'an.

ayahs.ar: رُبَمَا يَوَدُّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا لَوْ كَانُوْا مُسْلِمِيْنَ ۝٢
ayahs.tr: Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish that they had been Muslims.

ayahs.ar: ذَرْهُمْ يَاْكُلُوْا وَيَتَمَتَّعُوْا وَيُلْهِهِمُ الْاَمَلُ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُوْنَ ۝٣
ayahs.tr: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا͏ٓ اَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ اِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعْلُوْمٌ ۝٤
ayahs.tr: And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree.

ayahs.ar: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ اُمَّةٍ اَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَاْخِرُوْنَ ۝٥
ayahs.tr: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوْا يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْ نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ الذِّكْرُ اِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُوْنٌ ۝٦ؕ
ayahs.tr: And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.

ayahs.ar: لَوْ مَا تَاْتِيْنَا بِالْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةِ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيْنَ ۝٧
ayahs.tr: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful?"

ayahs.ar: مَا نُنَزِّلُ الْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةَ اِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوْٓا اِذًا مُّنْظَرِيْنَ ۝٨
ayahs.tr: We do not send down the angels except with truth; and the disbelievers would not then be reprieved.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا الذِّكْرَ وَاِنَّا لَهٗ لَحٰفِظُوْنَ ۝٩
ayahs.tr: Indeed, it is We who sent down the Qur'an and indeed, We will be its guardian.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فِيْ شِيَعِ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ ۝١٠
ayahs.tr: And We had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [O Muhammad], among the sects of the former peoples.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يَاْتِيْهِمْ مِّنْ رَّسُوْلٍ اِلَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ يَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ ۝١١
ayahs.tr: And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him.

ayahs.ar: كَذٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهٗ فِيْ قُلُوْبِ الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ ۝١٢ۙ
ayahs.tr: Thus do We insert denial into the hearts of the criminals.

ayahs.ar: لَا يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ بِهٖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ ۝١٣
ayahs.tr: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.

ayahs.ar: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ بَابًا مِّنَ السَّمَا࢜ءِ فَظَلُّوْا فِيْهِ يَعْرُجُوْنَ ۝١٤ۙ
ayahs.tr: And [even] if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend,

ayahs.ar: لَقَالُوْٓا اِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ اَبْصَارُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَّسْحُوْرُوْنَ ۝١٥ࣖ
ayahs.tr: They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic."

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِي السَّمَا࢜ءِ بُرُوْجًا وَّزَيَّنّٰهَا لِلنّٰظِرِيْنَ ۝١٦ۙ
ayahs.tr: And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers.

ayahs.ar: وَحَفِظْنٰهَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطٰنٍ رَّجِيْمٍ ۝١٧ۙ
ayahs.tr: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allah]

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا مَنِ اسْتَرَقَ السَّمْعَ فَاَتْبَعَهٗ شِهَابٌ مُّبِيْنٌ ۝١٨
ayahs.tr: Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame.

ayahs.ar: وَالْاَرْضَ مَدَدْنٰهَا وَاَلْقَيْنَا فِيْهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَاَنۢ͏ْبَتْنَا فِيْهَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مَّوْزُوْنٍ ۝١٩
ayahs.tr: And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing.

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيْهَا مَعَايِشَ وَمَنْ لَّسْتُمْ لَهٗ بِرٰزِقِيْنَ ۝٢٠
ayahs.tr: And We have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنْ مِّنْ شَيْءٍ اِلَّا عِنْدَنَا خَزَا࢜ىِٕنُهٗؗ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهٗٓ اِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُوْمٍ ۝٢١
ayahs.tr: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known measure.

ayahs.ar: وَاَرْسَلْنَا الرِّيٰحَ لَوَاقِحَ فَاَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَا࢜ءِ مَا࢜ءً فَاَسْقَيْنٰكُمُوْهُۚ وَمَا͏ٓ اَنْتُمْ لَهٗ بِخٰزِنِيْنَ ۝٢٢
ayahs.tr: And We have sent the fertilizing winds and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْيٖ وَنُمِيْتُ وَنَحْنُ الْوٰرِثُوْنَ ۝٢٣
ayahs.tr: And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَقْدِمِيْنَ مِنْكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَاْخِرِيْنَ ۝٢٤
ayahs.tr: And We have already known the preceding [generations] among you, and We have already known the later [ones to come].

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْؕ اِنَّهٗ حَكِيْمٌ عَلِيْمٌ ۝٢٥ࣖ
ayahs.tr: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِّنْ حَمَاٍ مَّسْنُوْنٍ ۝٢٦ۚ
ayahs.tr: And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.

ayahs.ar: وَالْجَا࢜نَّ خَلَقْنٰهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ مِنْ نَّارِ السَّمُوْمِ ۝٢٧
ayahs.tr: And the jinn We created before from scorching fire.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةِ اِنِّيْ خَالِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِّنْ حَمَاٍ مَّسْنُوْنٍ ۝٢٨
ayahs.tr: And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.

ayahs.ar: فَاِذَا سَوَّيْتُهٗ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيْهِ مِنْ رُّوْحِيْ فَقَعُوْا لَهٗ سٰجِدِيْنَ ۝٢٩
ayahs.tr: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."

ayahs.ar: فَسَجَدَ الْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ اَجْمَعُوْنَ ۝٣٠ۙ
ayahs.tr: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا͏ٓ اِبْلِيْسَؕ اَبٰٓي اَنْ يَّكُوْنَ مَعَ السّٰجِدِيْنَ ۝٣١
ayahs.tr: Except Iblees, he refused to be with those who prostrated.

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يٰٓاِبْلِيْسُ مَا لَكَ اَلَّا تَكُوْنَ مَعَ السّٰجِدِيْنَ ۝٣٢
ayahs.tr: [Allah] said, O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَمْ اَكُنْ لِّاَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهٗ مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِّنْ حَمَاٍ مَّسْنُوْنٍ ۝٣٣
ayahs.tr: He said, "Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَاِنَّكَ رَجِيْمٌ ۝٣٤ۙ
ayahs.tr: [Allah] said, "Then get out of it, for indeed, you are expelled.

ayahs.ar: وَّاِنَّ عَلَيْكَ اللَّعْنَةَ اِلٰي يَوْمِ الدِّيْنِ ۝٣٥
ayahs.tr: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ فَاَنْظِرْنِيْٓ اِلٰي يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُوْنَ ۝٣٦
ayahs.tr: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَاِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِيْنَ ۝٣٧ۙ
ayahs.tr: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved

ayahs.ar: اِلٰي يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُوْمِ ۝٣٨
ayahs.tr: Until the Day of the time well-known."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَا͏ٓ اَغْوَيْتَنِيْ لَاُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِي الْاَرْضِ وَلَاُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ ۝٣٩ۙ
ayahs.tr: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them on earth, and I will mislead them all

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِيْنَ ۝٤٠
ayahs.tr: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسْتَقِيْمٌ ۝٤١
ayahs.tr: [Allah] said, "This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ عِبَادِيْ لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطٰنٌ اِلَّا مَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْغٰوِيْنَ ۝٤٢
ayahs.tr: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ ۝٤٣ࣞۙ
ayahs.tr: And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all.

ayahs.ar: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ اَبْوَابٍؕ لِكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَّقْسُوْمٌ ۝٤٤ࣖ
ayahs.tr: It has seven gates; for every gate is of them a portion designated."

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ فِيْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُيُوْنٍ ۝٤٥ؕ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs.

ayahs.ar: اُدْخُلُوْهَا بِسَلٰمٍ اٰمِنِيْنَ ۝٤٦
ayahs.tr: [Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]."

ayahs.ar: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِيْ صُدُوْرِهِمْ مِّنْ غِلٍّ اِخْوَانًا عَلٰي سُرُرٍ مُّتَقٰبِلِيْنَ ۝٤٧
ayahs.tr: And We will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment, [so they will be] brothers, on thrones facing each other.

ayahs.ar: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيْهَا نَصَبٌ وَّمَا هُمْ مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِيْنَ ۝٤٨
ayahs.tr: No fatigue will touch them therein, nor from it will they [ever] be removed.

ayahs.ar: نَبِّي͏ٔ͏ْ عِبَادِيْٓ اَنِّيْٓ اَنَا الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ ۝٤٩ۙ
ayahs.tr: [O Muhammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful.

ayahs.ar: وَاَنَّ عَذَابِيْ هُوَ الْعَذَابُ الْاَلِيْمُ ۝٥٠
ayahs.tr: And that it is My punishment which is the painful punishment.

ayahs.ar: وَنَبِّي͏ٔ͏ْهُمْ عَنْ ضَيْفِ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ ۝٥١ۘ
ayahs.tr: And inform them about the guests of Abraham,

ayahs.ar: اِذْ دَخَلُوْا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوْا سَلٰمًاؕ قَالَ اِنَّا مِنْكُمْ وَجِلُوْنَ ۝٥٢
ayahs.tr: When they entered upon him and said, "Peace." [Abraham] said, "Indeed, we are fearful of you."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْا لَا تَوْجَلْ اِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلٰمٍ عَلِيْمٍ ۝٥٣
ayahs.tr: [The angels] said, "Fear not. Indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اَبَشَّرْتُمُوْنِيْ عَلٰٓي اَنْ مَّسَّنِيَ الْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُوْنَ ۝٥٤
ayahs.tr: He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform?"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْا بَشَّرْنٰكَ بِالْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُنْ مِّنَ الْقٰنِطِيْنَ ۝٥٥
ayahs.tr: They said, "We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ وَمَنْ يَّقْنَطُ مِنْ رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهٖٓ اِلَّا الضَّا࢜لُّوْنَ ۝٥٦
ayahs.tr: He said, "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ اَيُّهَا الْمُرْسَلُوْنَ ۝٥٧
ayahs.tr: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْٓا اِنَّا͏ٓ اُرْسِلْنَا͏ٓ اِلٰي قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِيْنَ ۝٥٨ۙ
ayahs.tr: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals,

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا͏ٓ اٰلَ لُوْطٍؕ اِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوْهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ ۝٥٩ۙ
ayahs.tr: Except the family of Lot; indeed, we will save them all

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا امْرَاَتَهٗ قَدَّرْنَا͏ٓۙ اِنَّهَا لَمِنَ الْغٰبِرِيْنَ ۝٦٠ࣖ
ayahs.tr: Except his wife." Allah decreed that she is of those who remain behind.

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا جَا࢜ءَ اٰلَ لُوْطِ اࣙلْمُرْسَلُوْنَ ۝٦١ۙ
ayahs.tr: And when the messengers came to the family of Lot,

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّنْكَرُوْنَ ۝٦٢
ayahs.tr: He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْا بَلْ جِي͏ٔ͏ْنٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوْا فِيْهِ يَمْتَرُوْنَ ۝٦٣
ayahs.tr: They said, "But we have come to you with that about which they were disputing,

ayahs.ar: وَاَتَيْنٰكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَاِنَّا لَصٰدِقُوْنَ ۝٦٤
ayahs.tr: And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful.

ayahs.ar: فَاَسْرِ بِاَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ الَّيْلِ وَاتَّبِعْ اَدْبَارَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنْكُمْ اَحَدٌ وَّامْضُوْا حَيْثُ تُو͏ٔ͏ْمَرُوْنَ ۝٦٥
ayahs.tr: So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded."

ayahs.ar: وَقَضَيْنَا͏ٓ اِلَيْهِ ذٰلِكَ الْاَمْرَ اَنَّ دَابِرَ هٰٓو͏ٔ͏ُلَا࢜ءِ مَقْطُوْعٌ مُّصْبِحِيْنَ ۝٦٦
ayahs.tr: And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning.

ayahs.ar: وَجَا࢜ءَ اَهْلُ الْمَدِيْنَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُوْنَ ۝٦٧
ayahs.tr: And the people of the city came rejoicing.

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اِنَّ هٰٓو͏ٔ͏ُلَا࢜ءِ ضَيْفِيْ فَلَا تَفْضَحُوْنِ ۝٦٨ۙ
ayahs.tr: [Lot] said, "Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me.

ayahs.ar: وَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَلَا تُخْزُوْنِ ۝٦٩
ayahs.tr: And fear Allah and do not disgrace me."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْٓا اَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۝٧٠
ayahs.tr: They said, "Have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ هٰٓو͏ٔ͏ُلَا࢜ءِ بَنٰتِيْٓ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ فٰعِلِيْنَ ۝٧١ؕ
ayahs.tr: [Lot] said, "These are my daughters - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]."

ayahs.ar: لَعَمْرُكَ اِنَّهُمْ لَفِيْ سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُوْنَ ۝٧٢
ayahs.tr: By your life, [O Muhammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly.

ayahs.ar: فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِيْنَ ۝٧٣ۙ
ayahs.tr: So the shriek seized them at sunrise.

ayahs.ar: فَجَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَاَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّنْ سِجِّيْلٍ ۝٧٤ؕ
ayahs.tr: And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِيْنَ ۝٧٥
ayahs.tr: Indeed in that are signs for those who discern.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيْلٍ مُّقِيْمٍ ۝٧٦
ayahs.tr: And indeed, those cities are [situated] on an established road.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّلْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ ۝٧٧ؕ
ayahs.tr: Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنْ كَانَ اَصْحٰبُ الْاَيْكَةِ لَظٰلِمِيْنَ ۝٧٨ۙ
ayahs.tr: And the companions of the thicket were [also] wrongdoers.

ayahs.ar: فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْۘ وَاِنَّهُمَا لَبِاِمَامٍ مُّبِيْنٍ ۝٧٩ؕࣖ
ayahs.tr: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ اَصْحٰبُ الْحِجْرِ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ ۝٨٠ۙ
ayahs.tr: And certainly did the companions of Thamud deny the messengers.

ayahs.ar: وَاٰتَيْنٰهُمْ اٰيٰتِنَا فَكَانُوْا عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِيْنَ ۝٨١ۙ
ayahs.tr: And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away.

ayahs.ar: وَكَانُوْا يَنْحِتُوْنَ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوْتًا اٰمِنِيْنَ ۝٨٢
ayahs.tr: And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure.

ayahs.ar: فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِيْنَ ۝٨٣ۙ
ayahs.tr: But the shriek seized them at early morning.

ayahs.ar: فَمَا͏ٓ اَغْنٰي عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا يَكْسِبُوْنَ ۝٨٤ؕ
ayahs.tr: So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا͏ٓ اِلَّا بِالْحَقِّؕ وَاِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَاٰتِيَةٌ فَاصْفَحِ الصَّفْحَ الْجَمِيْلَ ۝٨٥
ayahs.tr: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الْخَلّٰقُ الْعَلِيْمُ ۝٨٦
ayahs.tr: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَيْنٰكَ سَبْعًا مِّنَ الْمَثَانِيْ وَالْقُرْاٰنَ الْعَظِيْمَ ۝٨٧
ayahs.tr: And We have certainly given you, [O Muhammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur'an.

ayahs.ar: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ اِلٰي مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهٖٓ اَزْوَاجًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ ۝٨٨
ayahs.tr: Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of the disbelievers, and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing to the believers

ayahs.ar: وَقُلْ اِنِّيْٓ اَنَا النَّذِيْرُ الْمُبِيْنُ ۝٨٩ۚ
ayahs.tr: And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner" -

ayahs.ar: كَمَا͏ٓ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَي الْمُقْتَسِمِيْنَ ۝٩٠ۙ
ayahs.tr: Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيْنَ جَعَلُوا الْقُرْاٰنَ عِضِيْنَ ۝٩١
ayahs.tr: Who have made the Qur'an into portions.

ayahs.ar: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ ۝٩٢ۙ
ayahs.tr: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all

ayahs.ar: عَمَّا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ ۝٩٣
ayahs.tr: About what they used to do.

ayahs.ar: فَاصْدَعْ بِمَا تُو͏ٔ͏ْمَرُ وَاَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ ۝٩٤
ayahs.tr: Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا كَفَيْنٰكَ الْمُسْتَهْزِءِيْنَ ۝٩٥ۙ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيْنَ يَجْعَلُوْنَ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُوْنَ ۝٩٦
ayahs.tr: Who make [equal] with Allah another deity. But they are going to know.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ اَنَّكَ يَضِيْقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُوْلُوْنَ ۝٩٧ۙ
ayahs.tr: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.

ayahs.ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُنْ مِّنَ السّٰجِدِيْنَ ۝٩٨ۙ
ayahs.tr: So exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].

ayahs.ar: وَاعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتّٰي يَاْتِيَكَ الْيَقِيْنُ ۝٩٩ࣖ
ayahs.tr: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty (death).
